title: Suspicious CreateRemoteThread Cross-Process Activity
description: Detects a process creating a remote thread in another process, consistent with classic process injection techniques
sigma: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=8 AND (NOT (SourceImage LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR SourceImage LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR SourceImage LIKE '%\\wininit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR SourceImage LIKE '%\\MsMpEng.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT SourceImage=TargetImage)
